frames.alt: a featureless gold metallic mannequin figure
fields: A featureless gold metallic mannequin figure. A small enclosed room covered entirely in white square ceramic tiles on the floor and walls. Gold metal, white ceramic tile, grey iron, and glass.
Standing upright facing forward with arms outstretched to either side and palms facing up.
White overhead light originating from a single bare bulb hanging from the ceiling.
A large circular iron storm-drain grate embedded in the center of the tiled room floor.
